speaker: abel_garnish
text: The plot is on the nail, Master Will. The book is here. The column beside Costard is open, and I have no total to read you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep it open. Nothing is played until Thursday. A tally of a rehearsal is a tally of air.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Air is what they pay for, if it makes them laugh. You have left Costard his remuneration and a door. I want another pass at the word before a yard hears it cold.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You shall have the pass, Will. You shall not have a new line set down because the yard is empty.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Set down, set down. The groundlings never paid a penny to hear what was set down. Give me the word to turn in my mouth, and I will give it back on Thursday.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: A total is a figure, Master Kemp. I will not write a number against a morning that has not been played. The margin stays blank.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou art solemn for a comedy, Abel. Let him turn the word. Thou wilt tick him when there is a yard, and not before.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Dick. Berowne is thine, and he talks enough for two. Do not feed Will a licence I have not given.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I am not feeding him. I am telling thee the truth of a Monday. Thursday at two of the clock the yard will take the talker and the fool, and it will not ask which of us was obedient at rehearsal.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The song is not this morning's labour. Sam is at home with the cuckoo until tomorrow. I will not have it barked in a cold yard before he has it on the breath.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The Princess is on my part, sir. I have her to the last scene. I do not have her in a gown yet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou wilt have the watchet when it is on thy back, and not before. Fifty shillings is still on the Cheapside book. The cloth is not a performance.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Fifty shillings for a gown that is not yet on his back, and my interest a blank. You keep a fine sense of where money should sit.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The fifty is Master Heminges's column, not mine. I keep lines. He keeps debts. Do not ask me to mix the ink.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are agreed. No total today. The gown is owed, and unpaid. Thursday is two of the clock. This morning is the comedy as far as the cold lets us.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And the end. Thou wilt not marry them off because a Monday is kinder than a Thursday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I marked a pause yesterday, alone. I did not soften the refusal. Leave it where I left it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: When the messenger comes in, sir, do I hold, or do I answer him quick?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou holdest. He has little to say. The less of it, the colder. We set that tomorrow with Sincler. Today thou art only sure of thy place.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Good. A boy who knows where he stands can be taught a note. A boy who is still hunting the nail cannot.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I know where I stand. In the door, with a word too big for the line you gave it. Remuneration. I shall say it as a man paid in air, and the groundlings will hear their own wages.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Say the word that is set down, Will. If Thursday adds, Garnish will tick what Thursday adds. Not this.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I have the pin in the margin and no stroke beside it. Your entrances are clean enough for a Monday, Master Will. I am not prompting from foul papers.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then we begin. Thou, Will Kemp, after the oath, and not before it. I will not have Costard in the first minute, eating the king's promise for a laugh.

speaker: will_kemp
text: By my hose, I can wait a minute. I cannot wait until they have forgotten why they came.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: They come Thursday. Today is for the breath and the marks. Nick, from the top of your part, and quieter than a yard. There is no yard.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Yes, Master Phillips. Sir, shall I speak her as if the ladies were already in the gallery?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Speak her as if they might be. Do not wink at a gallery that is empty. Thou art not yet playing her to the street.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Places. The oath first. I turn the plot. If any man adds a line, he will see me not write it.
